name: Kraftshala
description: Kraftshala is an online course platform offering two highly popular programs: Digital Marketing Course and Sales Course. With a focus on bridging the gap between academic learning and industry demands, Kraftshala has the highest placement rate of 94% in India, and salary packages starting from ₹ 4.5 LPA for digital marketing students, and ₹ 7.5 LPA for sales students. Kraftshala's mission is to deliver practical, job-ready education that helps students secure rewarding career opportunities.
